name: @beauclick/chat-contract
description: The browser-safe half of the internal-chat contract: the counterparty vocabulary, the closed refusal vocabulary, report reasons and lifecycle, moderation actions, and the size, poll, throttle, window and retention limits. Zero dependencies, no framework, no TypeORM -- so the Next.js bundle and the NestJS server share ONE definition instead of two that drift. Deliberately carries NO attachment type or field.
